spans.s: अणि(णी) m. 1. A pin of the axle; 2. a limit, a boundary.
अणि(णी) m. 1. A pin of the axle; 2. a limit, a boundary.
आणि m.f. 1. The part of the leg just above the knee; 2. the edge of a sword; 3. the pin of the axle of a cart.
अणिमन् m. 1. Minuteness; 2. atomic nature; 3. the superhuman power of making oneself infinitely small, being one of the eight Siddhis.
